chunks: And when Jesus came with the clear proofs, he said: 'I have come to you with wisdom, and to explain to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me.'
ai.seo_question: What was the purpose of Jesus's mission according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Az-Zukhruf highlights Jesus (Isa) as a bearer of 'Al-Hikmah' (Wisdom), specifically tasked with resolving the jurisprudential and theological disputes among the Children of Israel regarding the Torah. It underscores his role not merely as a miracle-worker, but as a divine legislator whose authority was rooted in God-consciousness (Taqwa) and direct obedience to Allah.
